title: ScumCraft:Legacy
description: This is a version of ScumCraft that's build on ScumCraft 4.6 if we didn't make the transition to fabric
body:
# Say Hello to ScumCraft:Legacy 
This is a Mod pack based on ScumCraft 4.6 the second to last version of ScumCraft to be made in forge.

## About the pack
This pack adds new building blocks, furniture, QOL Changes, and Optimizations.

### What's the purpose of the pack?
Mostly just to explore the Idea of what this pack would have been like if the original pack had stayed on forge.

### What's the difference between this and Normal/Reborn?
Well normal stops getting updates after like 5.1. reborn continuously gets updated and supported (bonus its on fabric).

### Will this pack get updates?
As long as I can, I already have updates planned for this pack, but it will probably just get superseded by reborn
